title: FAA expands AI advice to manage air traffic congestion across entire US airspace
summary: Airlines praised the AI tool, but the air traffic controllers’ union wasn’t involved.
llm_summary: The FAA has rolled out an artificial‑intelligence system that offers real‑time routing suggestions to help reduce congestion across the entire U.S. airspace, and airlines are hailing the tool for its potential to speed up flights and cut delays. However, the air‑traffic controllers’ union was not consulted on the rollout and has voiced concerns about relying on AI without proper input from the people who actually manage the skies.
